title: Multi-CONDOR: Learning Multistable Motion Primitives from Demonstration
abstract: arXiv:2611.21059v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Dynamical-system-based motion policies provide a framework for learning reactive robot motions with stability and convergence properties. Many manipulation tasks, however, admit several distinct goals or a continuous set of acceptable outcomes, requiring motion primitives that preserve these alternatives. Accommodating both goal structures within a unified framework with continuous, autonomous dynamics remains an open challenge. We propose a CONDOR-based framework, multi-CONDOR, for learning motion primitives with either multiple discrete attractors or a continuous attracting goal contour. The approach combines imitation learning with losses that encourage agreement between the learned task dynamics and latent reference systems encoding the desired attraction structure. We provide a Lyapunov-based analysis of the convergence properties of the learned motion dynamics. We evaluate the framework on simulated benchmarks with discrete goals

translated_title: Multi-CONDOR：从演示中学习多稳态运动基元
translated_abstract: 基于动力系统的运动策略为学习具有稳定性和收敛特性的响应式机器人运动提供了一个框架。然而，许多操作任务存在多个不同的目标或一个连续的可接受结果集合，这要求运动基元能够保留这些备选方案。如何在一个具有连续、自主动力学的统一框架中同时容纳这两种目标结构，仍然是一个悬而未决的挑战。我们提出了一种基于CONDOR的框架——multi-CONDOR，用于学习具有多个离散吸引子或连续吸引目标轮廓的运动基元。该方法将模仿学习与损失函数相结合，这些损失函数促使学习到的任务动力学与编码期望吸引结构的潜在参考系统之间保持一致。我们对学习到的运动动力学的收敛特性提供了基于Lyapunov（李雅普诺夫）的分析。我们在具有离散目标的仿真基准上对该框架进行了评估。
tldr: 该论文提出multi-CONDOR框架，能从演示中学习具有多个离散吸引子或连续吸引目标轮廓的多稳态运动基元，并通过Lyapunov分析保证其收敛特性。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes multi-CONDOR, a framework for learning multistable motion primitives from demonstration that supports either multiple discrete attractors or a continuous attracting goal contour, with Lyapunov-based convergence guarantees.
